proposed_statement_changes.reason: The original compatibility biconditional omitted the stability and positive-innovation checks required by the compatible-fiber definition. The recursive uniqueness claim is unchanged, but sufficiency is true only when those checks are included.

At an empty compatible fiber, universal equality of all transfer elements is vacuous, while the mandated output is incompatibility. Conditioning the singleton-transfer clause on nonemptiness makes the three output cases disjoint and logically exact.

The frozen regular class permits a zero diagonal persistence. For odd subsampling the inverse diagonal map then has an unbounded derivative and generally has a non-root-n, non-Gaussian limit. Uniform Wald inference therefore requires separation of the diagonal root derivative. A nonempty frequency grid and an allowed queried edge are also required for exact, rather than conservative or degenerate, nominal coverage.

proposed.consumer: It lets a scientist recover a queried edge without solving the full matrix polynomial whenever the ancestral recursion is regular.
